summary: Iteration 128: TRMM Scheduled Broadcasts - All 44 tests PASSED. Verified all new scheduled broadcast endpoints: POST /api/trmm/scheduled-broadcasts (503 when not configured, 400 for missing agent_ids, 400 for missing command/script_id, 400 for missing run_at, 400 for invalid ISO datetime, 400 for invalid repeat value, 400 for >200 agents, success returns {success:true, id:'sched-...', run_at, repeat}). GET /api/trmm/scheduled-broadcasts returns pending items sorted by run_at ASC. GET with include_completed=true shows completed/cancelled. GET /{id} returns full doc, 404 for bogus. DELETE /{id} cancels pending (status=cancelled), 404 for already-cancelled or bogus. E2E scheduler loop tests: once-repeat schedule fires within 35s and becomes 'completed' with runs_count=1 and last_broadcast_id referencing actual bcast- doc. Daily-repeat schedule fires and stays 'pending' with run_at bumped +24h. Cancelled schedules NOT picked up by loop. All regression tests for iterations 122-127 pass.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All scheduled broadcast endpoints verified working. POST /api/trmm/scheduled-broadcasts creates a scheduled broadcast with run_at datetime and optional repeat (once|daily|weekly). The scheduler loop in server.py runs every 30s (with 20s initial delay) and fires due schedules. For once-repeat, status becomes 'completed'. For daily/weekly, status stays 'pending' and run_at is bumped. Cancelled schedules are ignored by the loop. Each fired schedule creates a broadcast doc in db.trmm_broadcasts with scheduled_id reference.
